title: Open Robotics RViz MapDisplay OccupancyGridUpdate Out-Of-Bounds Read Denial-of-Service Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-134046)
description: A denial-of-service vulnerability exists in Open Robotics RViz due to improper validation of OccupancyGridUpdate messages, allowing out-of-bounds reads. Network-adjacent attackers can exploit this without authentication to cause a denial-of-service condition.
